note: Atlas rig for rung 3 (Milo A): ONE rig for both stills, because neutral and happy are the same pose and a rig that moved between them would make the eyes jump in the cross-fade. Eye cx 588.4 / 757.7 are the dark-mass column centroids, and they straddle the mouth's cx at 672 - that agreement is what validates them. ap_rx 34 and ap_ry 27 are NOT read off a classifier: the CG still's sclera is warm-tinted and its iris amber, so every colour rule that worked on Elliot's blue eye either caught the brow here or stopped at the limbus. They come from a sweep that rendered a closed eye at each candidate and COUNTED the iris pixels still showing, choosing the smallest aperture that leaves none (43 of 2063 at 1920x1080). lid_band is positive because his brow sits on the crease, so there is no clean upper lid to sample.
